title: Dorado Basecalling Pipeline - Parameters
description: Nextflow DSL2 pipeline for Oxford Nanopore Dorado basecalling.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to directory containing pod5 files or barcode subfolders.
input.help_text: The pipeline auto-detects whether the directory contains flat pod5 files or barcode subfolders. If subfolders are found, each is processed as a separate parallel job.

outdir.description: Output directory for BAM files and logs.

basecalling_options.title: Basecalling options
basecalling_options.description: Options controlling the Dorado basecalling model.

model.help_text: 'hac' (High Accuracy) is faster; 'sup' (Super Accuracy) is more accurate but slower.

generic_options.title: Generic options
